title: Launcher: `recover` on a committed run killed between its first two records gives the request-only explanation
outcome: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs recover RUN_DIR` on a committed-input run that holds only request.json (killed between its two first records) says no tests ran and gives the registration correction, as `summary` does, instead of failing with a raw ENOENT; or docs/test.md says to use `summary` for such a run.
acceptance: Launcher: `recover` on a committed run killed between its first two records gives the request-only explanation is done
